title: Show the engine run ID in the Overview row; engine-row edge cases
lead: Seen 2026-10-20: ork approve and ork stop take the engine run id (ork-...), but the Overview row shows only the slice and stage, so the owner reads the id from ork status. Until S25 adds keys, show the id on the row or its detail.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Seen 2026-10-20: ork approve and ork stop take the engine run id (ork-...), but the Overview row shows only the slice and the state. The id is in the row's engineID field only (internal/tui/overview.go:125), so it is not on the row or its detail line. The owner reads it from ork status.

This item also takes in the retired S41 (its three items are below):
- A setup project (no .slicer/) with an engine run counts the wait in its badge but shows no row (overview.go:68-71).
- Engine rows under Running are not padded to the width of the started-elsewhere rows (overview.go:127-131 leave kindW at 0; the external rows set it at :142).
- A ledger run linked to a committed or superseded engine run is hidden by design (overview.go:98, 134-136), but no test or doc says so.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- internal/tui/overview.go: the engine row built at :125 (id and text), running engine rows at :127-131 (kindW), the setup skip at :68-71 (Open, see Implement).
- internal/tui/engine_runs_test.go: new row tests (TestEngineRunRows at :25 is the neighbour to extend).
- internal/tui/tui_test.go: TestDownReachesAStoppedRunForEnter (:675-695) expects the detail prefix "S21  stopped" at :688; it becomes "engine  S21  stopped".
- testdata/golden/engine-*.txt and testdata/golden/overview-*.txt: every engine row changes. Regenerate with go test ./internal/tui -update and review the diff.
- docs/dashboard.md: lines 106-110 say an engine row leads with the slice, state and wait; add the run id and the hidden-linked-run rule.
- Unchanged: internal/tui/pane.go:94 already shows the run id in the pane header.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- An engine run row starts with its ork-... id, then the slice and state (new TestEngineRowLeadsWithRunID).
- The detail line of the selected engine row shows the same id (detailText, as in TestSelectedRowShowsItsFullTextOnTheDetailLine at tui_test.go:733).
- A ledger-only (started elsewhere) row shows its own slicer run id and no ork-... id (TestLedgerRowShowsNoEngineID).
- A running engine row and a started-elsewhere row put their item or ID text in the same column (TestRunningEngineRowsPadLikeExternalRows).
- A ledger run linked to a committed or superseded engine run has no row, and docs/dashboard.md says so (TestLinkedLedgerRunHiddenByDesign plus a doc check).
- A setup project's engine run: a row or a hint, as the owner decides (see Open in Implement).
- Golden views, colour and monochrome, list the id (TestGoldenEngineRuns, TestGoldenViews).

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the new tests first in internal/tui/engine_runs_test.go: TestEngineRowLeadsWithRunID, TestLedgerRowShowsNoEngineID, TestRunningEngineRowsPadLikeExternalRows, TestLinkedLedgerRunHiddenByDesign. Run go test ./internal/tui -run 'TestEngineRow|TestLedgerRow|TestRunningEngineRows|TestLinkedLedger' and watch each fail for its stated reason.
2. Change TestDownReachesAStoppedRunForEnter (internal/tui/tui_test.go:688) to expect the prefix "engine  S21  stopped".
3. In internal/tui/overview.go:125 make the run id the row's kept id, id first as runParts does (overview.go:294-304): ovRow{engineID: r.ID, id: r.ID, rest: r.Item + "  " + rest, text: r.ID + "  " + r.Item + "  " + rest, ...}. rowText (overview.go:262-279) keeps id whole and cuts rest first. The detail line reads text (detailLines, overview.go:283).
4. In overview.go:127-131 give running engine rows kindW: len(kindExternal), so they pad like the external rows at :142.
5. Mutation-check: revert step 3 and confirm the id tests go red for the right reason; restore.
6. Add the docs line in docs/dashboard.md:106-110: the engine row leads with the ork run id, then slice, state and wait; a ledger run linked to a committed or superseded engine run is not shown.
7. Regenerate the goldens: go test ./internal/tui -update, then review testdata/golden/engine-*.txt and overview-*.txt by hand (ids present, cut lines at 80x24 still fit).
8. Open: a setup project (.slicer/ missing) with an engine run gets no row (overview.go:68-71), while the badge counts it (S41 item 1). Options: (a) a row under Needs you; (b) keep the hint line only (dashboard.md:50-53). Recommendation: (a), so the badge and the rows agree. Owner to decide.
Open: the Why of the item says "Until S25 adds keys". Keys a, x and t already exist (internal/tui/model.go:335-340), so that sentence is stale and was not used here.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- go test -race -count=1 ./internal/tui
- go test ./internal/tui -update, then review every changed file in testdata/golden/ (engine-*.txt, overview-*.txt) by eye; the diff should show only the id and the padding.
- go test -race -count=1 ./internal/tui after the update, so the goldens pass.
- go vet ./...
- gofmt -l .
- slicer check (docs/dashboard.md must not be stale against the render).
- adj lint
- Look at: testdata/golden/overview-80x24-mono.txt (cut rows keep the whole id) and testdata/golden/engine-stopped-80x24.txt.
